description: This source file defines a React custom hook 'useTabVisibility' that manages document visibility state and counts how many times the tab has been hidden. It uses React's useState and useEffect hooks to listen for visibility change events and provides visibility status and count as return values.

methods.name: useTabVisibility(onHidden)
methods.description: A custom React hook that tracks whether the document tab is hidden and counts the number of times it becomes hidden. It accepts an optional callback 'onHidden' invoked when the tab is hidden.
